body:
## Pull request overview

Implements multiple L2 roadmap enhancements across the console and related plugin packages (presence indicators, Kanban swimlanes, embeddable form URL prefill, shared-link protection UI, undo/redo toasts, and comment sorting/reactions), plus accompanying tests and roadmap updates.

**Changes:**
- Add PresenceAvatars to the console header and record detail view; add comment reactions + sort dropdown in CommentThread.
- Add Kanban swimlane grouping (`swimlaneField`) end-to-end, plus embeddable form URL prefill and SharedViewLink password/expiration UI.
- Integrate global undo/redo toast notifications and update ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md; add new test coverage for the new features.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 14 out of 14 changed files in this pull request and generated 12 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/App.tsx | Hooks global undo/redo to Sonner toasts and refresh triggers. |
| apps/console/src/components/AppHeader.tsx | Adds PresenceAvatars support (currently with mock fallback). |
| apps/console/src/components/RecordDetailView.tsx | Adds per-record PresenceAvatars and wires CommentThread reactions. |
| packages/collaboration/src/CommentThread.tsx | Adds sort dropdown and emoji reactions rendering/callbacks. |
| packages/collaboration/src/__tests__/CommentThreadSortReactions.test.tsx | Tests sort dropdown behavior and reaction callbacks. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/types.ts | Extends KanbanSchema with `swimlaneField`. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx | Plumbs `swimlaneField` from schema into Kanban board. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx | Implements swimlane layout (collapsible lanes, counts) and rendering changes. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/KanbanSwimlanes.test.tsx | Tests swimlane headers, collapse/expand, and counts. |
| packages/plugin-form/src/EmbeddableForm.tsx | Adds URL search-param parsing for initial form data prefill. |
| packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/EmbeddableFormPrefill.test.tsx | Tests URL prefill and precedence rules. |
| packages/plugin-view/src/SharedViewLink.tsx | Adds password + expiration UI and extends onShare options payload. |
| packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/SharedViewLinkPassword.test.tsx | Tests new SharedViewLink password/expiration behavior. |
| ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md | Updates roadmap statuses and notes for newly implemented L2 items. |
</details>

The “Oldest” sort option doesn’t actually sort by `createdAt` (it returns `roots` in the incoming array order). To make the label accurate and robust, sort ascending by `createdAt` when `sortOrder === 'oldest'` as well (and handle invalid dates deterministically).

The added reaction UI styling uses hard-coded hex colors in inline styles (e.g. `reactionBtnActive`, `reactionPicker`). These won’t adapt to theming/dark mode like the rest of the console UI. Prefer theme tokens/CSS variables or Tailwind `className`s for these new styles.

The “Expires after” label isn’t associated with the `<select>` (no `htmlFor`/`id`), which reduces accessibility. Add matching `id`/`htmlFor` (or provide an `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby`) so assistive tech can correctly announce the control.

Untrusted URL search-param keys are written into a plain object (`data[key] = value`). Keys like `__proto__`/`constructor` can cause prototype-pollution style edge cases and surprising behavior downstream. Prefer `Object.create(null)` for the accumulator and/or explicitly ignore dangerous keys before assignment.

The “Password protection” label isn’t programmatically associated with the password input (no `htmlFor`/`id` relationship). Add an `id` to the input and `htmlFor` to the label (or wrap the input in the label) to improve screen reader and click-target behavior.

`userEvent` is imported but never used in this test file. Removing unused imports keeps the test code clean and avoids lint/TS warnings.

This file defines a local `cn()` helper even though it already depends on `@object-ui/components`. To keep class merging consistent and avoid duplicated utilities, import and use the shared `cn` from `@object-ui/components` instead of maintaining a local implementation here.
